scope: Theorem 9.2 (Spacetime Penrose inequality for complete initial data) of the manuscript “Spacetime Penrose inequalities: enclosing area, charge, and rigidity” (preprints/Spacetime-Penrose-inequalities-enclosing-area-charge-and-rigidity-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 260 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 794bf524061c4b36), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the complete initial data just specified, every chosen end and every admissible boundary satisfy (9.2) E > |P|δ, q E2 − |P|2 δ ≥ s Amin(S) 16π . Here (E, P) is the ADM vector of the chosen end. The assertion allows finitely many ends and disconnected admissible boundaries.
